# FARO Retreat 2026

::: {.post-meta}
Sept 22, 2026
:::

`r img_html("news_faro2026", alt = "FARO retreat 2026", class = "post-image")`

It has been a pleasure for our group to co-organize the Focal Area of Research in Oncology (FARO) retreat 2026 at Weggis, together with Mattia Zampieri! 

We have an amazing experimental oncology and hematology community in Basel, from target discovery and preclinical mechanistic studies all the way to implementing novel cellular immunotherapies and advancing personalized medicine.

Thank you to all contributing group leaders, postdocs and students!
